## Problem

`template/src/pdca_harness/gates.py` line 38 (main) still says, in the evidence-marker paragraph:

> the exit code alone decides pass/fail, and ``PDCA-UNVERIFIABLE`` stays the one marker that can change a ``result``.

Twenty lines below, the same module doc introduces ``PDCA-DEFERRED`` (#401) — a second marker that changes a ``result`` (to `deferred`, `DEFERRED_MARKER` at line 98). The sentence was written before #401's fix landed and is now false.

Flagged in pdca-pdca's issue_401 cycle (SUMMARY §10): "stale once PDCA-DEFERRED lands; fix the sentence in a follow-up" — it landed, and the sentence is still there.

## Fix

One-line docs change, e.g. "…and only the ``PDCA-UNVERIFIABLE``/``PDCA-DEFERRED`` declarations can change a ``result``."
title: gates.py module doc: "PDCA-UNVERIFIABLE stays the one marker that can change a result" — false since PDCA-DEFERRED landed
